trigger: GET /api/audit?limit=-1 or MCP query_audit_log {limit:-1} from any AuditLog:Read holder
summary: Negative limit reaches PG as LIMIT -1, errors, and is reported as a store DEGRADE: 503 plus the read-degrade counter YuzuAuditReadDegraded pages on. Any read-privileged client can fire the evidence-availability alert at will.

trigger: backlog probe fails after a cap-bound pass
summary: Doc said the post-delete backlog probe fires after a SUCCESSFUL delete; on PG the whole pass is one txn so the probe failure rolls the DELETE back.

trigger: total_count() pool timeout while query() succeeded
summary: Degraded total reported as the page size — count==total reads as 'this page is the whole trail'. Also raised by cpp-expert (HIGH) and by architect in an earlier round; max severity taken.

trigger: >1h clock divergence between replicas
summary: Cross-replica clock divergence makes two replicas alternate fact sets that never match, each declining. Safe direction, but undocumented.

trigger: unresolved
summary: result/principal_class sanitized on the backfill path but bound verbatim on the live write. Same defect cpp-expert F2 later MEASURED.

adjudicated_by: orchestrator (severity re-derived from the agent's I3 to I7)
trigger: any reader following the citation
summary: ADR cited a nonexistent ADR-0039 (ResponseStore) five times as the source of both conventions it builds on; architect A-9 added a nonexistent ADR-0038. Neither store is on PG. Re-derived as SHOULD: a false citation in a normative doc is I7, not a wrong runtime result.

trigger: discovery-time consumer of the self-describing schema
summary: /audit OpenAPI entry documented only 200 after this diff added a 503 branch; its sibling /audit/auth-sample already documented 503.

summary: MCP maps a retryable availability degrade to kInternalError with no retry hint while REST returns 503 + retry_after_ms; and /audit/auth-sample has no MCP twin and no ADR-1005 ledger exception.

summary: ServerImpl's ctor sets startup_failed_ and keeps constructing; nine log() sites guarded only on is_open(). A boot that refuses to serve still writes native rows ahead of the marker and wedges every later boot. Falsified the comment that justified omitting the guard.

trigger: agent ran the [audit] tag after mutating the A-1 guard
summary: Claimed the A-1 guard has zero regression coverage. REJECTED: it ran [audit] (450 assertions), which contains none of the A-1 tests; those are [pg][audit_store][backfill]. Disabling the guard fails 2 cases / 4 assertions, verified by me and independently by quality-engineer and by an external reviewer.

trigger: result="suc\0cess" or invalid UTF-8 from any future non-literal caller
summary: MEASURED on PG 18: an embedded NUL stored 'suc' (silently truncated audit result); invalid UTF-8 failed the INSERT and lost the event on a fail-hard path.

trigger: reader of the changed headers
summary: Four false comments left by the port: a deleted reader lock, a 'ported verbatim' rationale that is condensed, a cleanup_failed enumeration naming a prepare/step that no longer exist and claiming the backlog probe fires after a successful delete, and reasoning about a four-character legacy value that cannot exist on a freshly migrated table.

trigger: legacy audit_retention_meta holding a non-INTEGER value
summary: The meta backfill used sqlite3_column_int64, coercing a corrupt reading to 0 — a usable anchor — and dropping the SQLite store's deliberate not-an-INTEGER detector.

trigger: server test suite startup
summary: Ten byte-identical PgTestTemplate definitions across audit-touching test files build ten template DBs per process on the shared instance whose contention PgTestTemplate exists to relieve.

summary: Reverting PERF-1's fix left the entire suite green: the only evidence was a hand-run EXPLAIN. A future revert would ship silently.

trigger: a future reorder of main.cpp's two calls
summary: The A-2 order contract has no end-to-end coverage: main.cpp is not linked into yuzu_server_tests, and the shell test that could drive it only exercises the no-legacy-file branch.

trigger: none — coverage gap
summary: start_cleanup()/stop_cleanup() had zero call sites in any test: join-on-destroy, double-stop and stop-mid-pass all unexercised.

trigger: none — coverage gap
summary: No test drove a legacy audit.db whose audit_events table exists but is empty — a distinct path from the sourceless exits.

trigger: sustained audit write rate above 25,000/h, or any one-off backlog
summary: 25k deletes x 1 pass/hour = 6.94 rows/s drain against a measured 3,801 tps write path; above that the evidence table grows permanently. A full pass measured 41-49ms, so the hour was doing all the damage.

trigger: any expired backlog with survivors present
summary: The survivor EXISTS probe flips to a Seq Scan proportional to the backlog (75,823 buffers / 151.8ms at 54% expired on 5M rows). Within the pass timeout; my comment claiming both halves are index-only was wrong and is corrected. The LIMIT-1 subquery rewrite is not applied.

trigger: every GET /api/audit
summary: total_count() is an unfiltered aggregate on every request: 13,682 buffers / 191.6ms at 5M rows, ~1.5s at 40M.

trigger: the CC7.2 auth-sample export where its prefixes are sparse in the window
summary: action LIKE 'prefix%' is unsargable under en_US.utf8: Parallel Seq Scan, 166,444 buffers / 153.4ms at 5M rows. Wants a text_pattern_ops index.

trigger: deep OFFSET pagination
summary: OFFSET 4,000,000 = 151,113 buffers / 790.7ms; a full paged export is O(n^2/page).

MEASURED by time instead: this change contributes ~3% of shard B's runtime (B 116.0s -> 113.4s when moved). Rebalanced anyway. Adjudicated MEDIUM, not the platform-leg floor: nothing is observably broken, it is an unverified projection.

trigger: macOS CI leg
summary: macOS leaves YUZU_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN unset so all [pg] cases skip: test_audit_store.cpp went from 0 [pg] cases (fully run on macOS) to 38 (all skipped). macOS coverage of this PR's core surface is now zero.

trigger: the ~[pg] shard
summary: A test calls YUZU_REQUIRE_PG_DB without a [pg] tag, so it skips in the ~[pg] shard — a partition violation. Untouched by this diff.

trigger: three Gate 3 agents given write access to one worktree
summary: Concurrent agents mutating one shared worktree contaminated each other: cpp-safety built from quality-engineer's in-flight mutation, and a phantom TEST_CASE from a stale object file appeared in a full-suite run. QE discarded and redid all four mutations under a clean-tree discipline. Future runs must give mutating agents their own worktree.
